card.name: Recurrence of a condition after treatment
card.fires_on: Words saying a condition comes back after treatment or recovery, such as recurrence, recur, returns, relapsed. Also the end of a condition name right after 'recurrence of'.

modes.label: Recurrence wording
modes.description: The word for a condition coming back after improvement or a break in therapy.
modes.example: of these, 10 had<< recurrence>> of hepatitis.

modes.label: End of the recurring condition
modes.description: The last piece of a condition name that follows recurrence wording.
modes.example: since recurrences of N<<MS>> have been reported.

modes.label: Delay or return of symptoms
modes.description: Words about symptoms returning or relapse being delayed.
modes.example: If a headache<< returns>> following an initial treatment with sumatript
